ios.desc:
Neo is a futuristic Matrix client built for speed, focus, and modern communication.

Move quickly through Matrix rooms, spaces, threads with a modern and clean UI. Sign in with your Matrix account, join rooms, send rich messages, organize conversations with Threads and Matrix Spaces, and navigate everything from a fast sidebar.

Neo supports encrypted rooms, image video sharing, reactions, threads, voice and video calls, rich notifications, RSS feeds, and local message translation with a single tap.

Core Matrix Features
• Sign in with username/password or SSO
• Support for regular and encrypted Matrix rooms
• Send text, images, videos, files, GIFs, stickers, and reactions
• Use threads to keep long conversations on track
• Organize rooms with native Matrix Spaces
• Rich notifications with avatars and message previews
• Voice and video calls

Neo Extras
• Fast sidebar navigation for rooms and spaces
• Online GIF picker powered by Tenor
• Message search
• One-tap downloads for images, videos, and GIFs
• RSS feed subscriptions and in-app reading
• News view with RSS integration
• Sticker picker, including Memoji stickers
• Per-contact notification modes
• Custom notification sounds
• Custom default reaction emojis
• Emoji folders
• Local message translation
• Foldable Markdown code blocks
• Apple Intelligence message summaries on supported devices
